context: Across all 12 teams, the week added up to 1678.36 points -- 139.86 on average.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Somewhere, Deebo Samuel Sr. is still on Big Dumb Sports's bench wondering why -- 30.9 points' worth of wondering, out of 59.8 total left stranded.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Jake From State Farm did the bare minimum (133.88, 7th in the league) and it was enough, because Bandits did even less (96.2).

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Jake From State Farm held Bandits to just 96.2 points -- the 12th-worst score in the league this week -- on the way to the win.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Not close: theMadgician beat VRDNO by 79.62 points, 183.34 to 103.72.
